items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Sie können gegen diesen Bescheid binnen zwei Wochen nach Zustellung Einspruch einlegen – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Musterland – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: Formal service (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) shows actual delivery on Sat 19.09.2026, so this actual date is used instead of a deemed-delivery fiction. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted; the two-week period starts Sun 20.09.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB, two weeks after a Saturday event ends on the corresponding weekday two weeks later: Sat 03.10.2026. That day is Tag der Deutschen Einheit, a nationwide public holiday (also a Saturday), so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Mon 05.10.2026.

items.title: Pay the total fine, fee and costs (Gesamtbetrag)
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.computation: If no Einspruch is filed, the decision becomes final (rechtskräftig) at the end of the Einspruch period, i.e. on 05.10.2026 (see the Einspruch item above). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day Rechtskraft occurs is not counted; the two-week payment period starts 06.10.2026. Per § 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB, two weeks after a Monday event ends on the corresponding Monday two weeks later: 19.10.2026, which is a normal working day, so no further shift applies.

warnings: The payment deadline (two weeks after Rechtskraft) only starts once the decision becomes final; it is void if an Einspruch is filed in time, so pay only after 05.10.2026 if no objection was raised.
The included envelope scan shows a delivery date (19.09.2026, Saturday) — verify this matches the actual date the envelope was received, since it is the anchor for the Einspruch deadline.

The IBAN (DE69 4145 0075 0000 0200 01, Sparkasse, BLZ 41450075) is a valid German account; still cross-check it against the Kreis Musterland's official channels before paying, as a general precaution for any payment demand.
